race.comment: Hard to go past KICKOFF (7) who is a former NSW galloper flying for the new yard. Just missed in a four-way photo fresh then arrived in time to score here last time. Fitter again and expected to go close again. AVENUE MONTAIGNE (6) was a winner two back in Cairns then tackled the rich Daintree there last time and ran well to finish fifth. This is much easier and looks a terrific chance to find winning form. FANCY GARTER (12) got home late to score in Cairns last time. Drawn to stalk a strong pace and worth including again. INSTA WORTHY (8) raced on speed in a Class 3 last time and rates a leading player. DANCE FOR ME RANDY (4) has a great record this trip and looks ready to show his best.
